deadline.value: The application deadline is December 15, 2026; materials by then are needed for financial assistance.
deadline.quote: The deadline for applications is December 15.

app_fee.value: The department lists a $50 processing fee; the Graduate School lists $60 for international applicants.

gre_general.value: The math pages do not mention the GRE.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is mentioned on the math pages.

supervisor.value: The math pages do not say whether a faculty sponsor is needed.

funding.value: All admitted students get a graduate assistantship with a $33,000 stipend for 12 months and full tuition remission.
funding.quote: all accepted students receive a Graduate Assistantship consisting of a stipend of $33,000 for 12 months, full tuition remission

also.quote: The Department of Mathematics offers Graduate Teaching Assistantships to all admitted students.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is required, and the department admits students only into the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Graduate School applicants must hold a bachelor's or equivalent professional degree.

also.quote: Please note that the Mathematics Department only accepts students applying to the PhD. Program.

notes: The math page's $50 processing fee differs from the Graduate School's $60 for international applicants; both are shown.
